en.title: Trails of the Azure Sky and the Sleepless Metropolis
en.premise: An era of light and smoke, where massive 'airships' soaring through the sky have become the hallmark of the age. The 'Sleepless City,' a metropolis of light that never sleeps, enjoys unprecedented prosperity—yet, to maintain its glow, it erodes the very laws of nature. A fallen former military officer turned sailor, a female engineer seeking dominance in the new era, and a shrine maiden who hears the voices of ancient gods. Three distinct versions of justice clash violently over the runaway energy that sustains the city.

zh.title: 苍天之辙与不夜之都
zh.premise: 这是一个光与烟雾的时代，巨大的“飞空艇”穿梭于天际，已成为时代的潮流。永不熄灭的光之城——“不夜之都”，在享受着前所未有的繁荣之余，也在为了维持那灯火而侵蚀着自然的法则。落魄的前武官船员、企图夺取新时代霸权的女性技师，以及能听见古神之声的巫女。围绕着支撑城市运转的暴走能源，三方截然不同的正义展开了激烈的碰撞。
